{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mul_subexpression(
    input [7:0] multiplicand,
    input [7:0] multiplier,
    output [15:0] product
);

// Constant elaboration functions describing a four-level Dadda tree.
function integer height;
    input integer st;
    input integer col;
    integer h [0:15];
    integer nh [0:15];
    integer s, k, target, incoming, excess, nf, na;
    begin
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
            if (k < 8) h[k] = k + 1;
            else h[k] = 15 - k;
        end
        for (s = 0; s < st; s = s + 1) begin
            case (s)
                0: target = 6;
                1: target = 4;
                2: target = 3;
                default: target = 2;
            endcase
            incoming = 0;
            for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
                excess = h[k] + incoming - target;
                if (excess < 0) excess = 0;
                nf = excess / 2;
                na = excess % 2;
                nh[k] = h[k] + incoming - 2*nf - na;
                incoming = nf + na;
            end
            for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1)
                h[k] = nh[k];
        end
        height = h[col];
    end
endfunction

function integer outgoing;
    input integer st;
    input integer col;
    integer k, target, carry, excess;
    begin
        case (st)
            0: target = 6;
            1: target = 4;
            2: target = 3;
            default: target = 2;
        endcase
        carry = 0;
        for (k = 0; k <= col; k = k + 1) begin
            excess = height(st,k) + carry - target;
            if (excess < 0) excess = 0;
            carry = (excess + 1) / 2;
        end
        outgoing = carry;
    end
endfunction

wire [7:0] heap [0:4][0:15];
wire [7:0] carries [0:3][0:15];
genvar c, b, s;
generate
    for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: initial_columns
        localparam integer H = height(0,c);
        localparam integer FIRST = (c < 8) ? 0 : c-7;
        for (b = 0; b < 8; b = b + 1) begin: bits_in_column
            if (b < H) begin: partial_product
                assign heap[0][c][b] = multiplicand[FIRST+b] & multiplier[c-FIRST-b];
            end else begin: unused
                assign heap[0][c][b] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
    for (s = 0; s < 4; s = s + 1) begin: reduction
        localparam integer TARGET = (s == 0) ? 6 : (s == 1) ? 4 : (s == 2) ? 3 : 2;
        for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: column
            localparam integer H = height(s,c);
            localparam integer INC = outgoing(s,c-1);
            localparam integer EXCESS = (H+INC > TARGET) ? H+INC-TARGET : 0;
            localparam integer NF = EXCESS/2;
            localparam integer NA = EXCESS%2;
            localparam integer LOCAL_BITS = H-2*NF-NA;
            localparam integer NEXT_H = height(s+1,c);
            for (b = 0; b < 8; b = b + 1) begin: compressor
                if (b < NF) begin: full_adder
                    assign heap[s+1][c][b] = heap[s][c][3*b] ^ heap[s][c][3*b+1] ^ heap[s][c][3*b+2];
                    assign carries[s][c][b] = (heap[s][c][3*b] & heap[s][c][3*b+1]) |
                                               (heap[s][c][3*b] & heap[s][c][3*b+2]) |
                                               (heap[s][c][3*b+1] & heap[s][c][3*b+2]);
                end else if (b < NF+NA) begin: half_adder
                    assign heap[s+1][c][b] = heap[s][c][3*NF] ^ heap[s][c][3*NF+1];
                    assign carries[s][c][b] = heap[s][c][3*NF] & heap[s][c][3*NF+1];
                end else begin: other
                    assign carries[s][c][b] = 1'b0;
                    if (b < LOCAL_BITS) begin: bypass
                        assign heap[s+1][c][b] = heap[s][c][b+2*NF+NA];
                    end else if ((b < NEXT_H) && (c > 0)) begin: carry_input
                        assign heap[s+1][c][b] = carries[s][c-1][b-LOCAL_BITS];
                    end else begin: padding
                        assign heap[s+1][c][b] = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate

// Parallel-prefix carry propagation for the two remaining rows.
wire [15:0] a, d, propagate;
wire [15:0] pg [0:4];
wire [15:0] gg [0:4];
generate
    for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: final_rows
        assign a[c] = heap[4][c][0];
        assign d[c] = heap[4][c][1];
    end
endgenerate
assign propagate = a ^ d;
assign pg[0] = propagate;
assign gg[0] = a & d;
generate
    for (s = 0; s < 4; s = s + 1) begin: prefix_level
        for (c = 0; c < 16; c = c + 1) begin: prefix_bit
            if (c >= (1 << s)) begin: combine
                assign gg[s+1][c] = gg[s][c] | (pg[s][c] & gg[s][c-(1 << s)]);
                assign pg[s+1][c] = pg[s][c] & pg[s][c-(1 << s)];
            end else begin: bypass
                assign gg[s+1][c] = gg[s][c];
                assign pg[s+1][c] = pg[s][c];
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate
assign product = propagate ^ {gg[4][14:0], 1'b0};
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse partial-product generation, several compressor-like mapped cells, and final carry-propagation logic before reaching the upper product bits.",
  "rewrite": "Replace serial row accumulation with a column-wise Dadda reduction using target heights 6, 4, 3, and 2. Each reduction level uses independent full and half adders without horizontal carry propagation within that level. Add the final two rows with an explicit four-level parallel-prefix carry network.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The balanced reduction and logarithmic final carry network target a lower maximum arrival than the 2.45 ns baseline. The actual gain requires mapping and STA under the specified flow; no measured improvement is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The prefix network adds carry-combination logic, while the Dadda tree limits compressor count. Constant functions operate only during elaboration and create no runtime arithmetic or storage. Mapped area, slew, and capacitance compliance require verification against the stated limits.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name and unsigned 8-bit inputs and 16-bit output, with no parameters added. Every partial product retains weight i+j, compressors preserve weighted sums, and the final addition retains the original 16-bit result. The design is fully combinational and covers every binary input combination without assumptions, latency, or undefined outputs."
}
